Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
I've forgot how Stanislava's ability works. Does it only work incombat or
can a blocking minion with Raven Spy not make use of that +1 intercept? I
also wonder who can block when a vamp tries to burn a card like Fleshcarf.
Isn't the minion having Fleshcraft the one that controls the card, and
doesn't the rules say that only the controller of the card can block? Or
that is only the case if it's another Meth who controls a card?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Roger Carhult wrote:
>
> I've forgot how Stanislava's ability works. Does it only work incombat or
> can a blocking minion with Raven Spy not make use of that +1 intercept? I

Combat. When memory fades, you can always fall back on card text. :-)
(A minion only ever "opposes" another in combat).

> also wonder who can block when a vamp tries to burn a card like Fleshcarf.

The controller of the card to be burned, unless it is controlled by
the controller of the acting minion. In the latter case, the prey and
predator can block. [6.2.2.1]

> Isn't the minion having Fleshcraft the one that controls the card, and

Yes. [1.6.3]

> doesn't the rules say that only the controller of the card can block? Or
> that is only the case if it's another Meth who controls a card?

Only the latter, yes. [6.2.2.1]
